scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The theorem concerns the multiplicity-weighted push-forward of classical large Schröder paths under binary diagonal-column incidence; it does not concern the indicator of its full binary support. Exact infinite proof uses a signed height transfer and a nonnegative surviving-path certificate. Finite checks independently corroborate small instances. An unindexed older position-refined Schröder enumerator may imply the classification; historical priority is not certified.
title: Exact half-space Fourier support of Schröder diagonal-column counts
